title: nertera granadensis var. tetrasperma
intro: Nertera granadensis var. tetrasperma, commonly known as the 'Dwarf Oregon Grape' or 'Piripiri', is a small, flowering plant native to New Zealand and Australia. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Nertera granadensis var. tetrasperma include wound healing, antimicrobial and antifungal activities, as well as potential anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthraquinone glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
